prompt:

Header text verbatim: "chockad". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "shocked".
Scene: An adult woman looking stunned at a phone message, hand at mouth and seated safely, screen text non-legible, no injury or medical scene.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "chockad = shocked; strongly surprised or upset.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon är chockad av nyheten.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
